title: Rats and Mice
body: Numerous internal and external treatments are available for rodents...

Our service for Rats and Mice is focused and we meticulously investigate to try to get to the root of the problem instead of just laying bait and returning to see what's eaten it. Most Mouse and Rat issues are due to exterior defects which we can rectify (or advise on) but some Rat infestations are due to faulty drainage and we can point you in the right direction if you need a CCTV drain survey to fully map your drainage system, which can uncover gaps, cracks, misaligned pipework and redundant drains. We aim to stop your infestations for good, not just for a few months.
We also offer a Proofing service too (see below).
